label: Devpost
terms_note: Public JSON used by the site (undocumented, anonymous). ToS forbids automated vote manipulation only; registration and submission happen on the hackathon's Devpost site.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit or API terms published (the endpoint is the site's own JSON; robots.txt answers 403 to non-browser clients, the API answered 200 to a platform-mcp User-Agent on 2026-09-24). One request per second.

search_postings.note: Undocumented public JSON used by devpost.com/hackathons: `?page=N&status[]=open` (open hackathons only, fixed); the page size is the site's fixed 9 (`meta.per_page`), so `limit` is not sent and `total` is meta.total_count. No keyword parameter: `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. `deadline` is the display string submission_period_dates (e.g. 'Jul 31 - Oct 01, 2026'), not ISO-8601; prize_amount (HTML), themes[], registrations_count, start_a_submission_url and invite_only stay in `raw`.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'No API for registration or submission — assist card with start_a_submission_url'; ToS forbids automated vote manipulation.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Details live on each hackathon's own site (HTML, 'not machine-readable'); re-read the record from the search hit.
